payload.text: LINUX AND BREW (hv, 2026-10-14): devbin and Intent work properly on Ubuntu, proven on kovacs, and install with brew on Linux and macOS (hv: "I want BOTH devbin and intent work from 'brew install' and for them to BOTH work seamlessly on Unix (the kovacs VM in this case)"). Restated by hv through another estate's session the same morning: through Homebrew on macOS and Linux, with nothing installed from a local repository, so the brew install becomes the machine install that projects vendor from; that estate waits on the first release that carries Linux binaries. Planned by devbin-vc and intent-vc with hv. kovacs-sysadm, a Remote Control session on kovacs, does the VM side on orders from either vc; there is one queue for kovacs, intent-vc's, with one order per step, each copied to the other vc. kovacs, read 2026-10-14: Ubuntu 26.04.1 on aarch64, 2 CPUs, 3.3 GiB, uutils coreutils 0.10.0, bats 1.13.0, GNU parallel 20240222; missing xmllint, shellcheck and brew; GitHub auth works as hv; hv's home is readable there at ~/mac, so a bundle goes in vc's scratch. Order: provisioning; Intent's bin/int linux build, package and smoke from a bundle of its main; Intent's AT-05.1; a user-level drive of Intent; devbin's Linux proof with Intent's package on PATH (main's HEAD by bundle, test all read from its seal, check all with the critic gate); brew last, as hv rules. devbin has no formula or tap and its repo is private; Intent's formula is macOS arm64 only by hv's ruling of 2026-08-15, and ST0081 scopes Homebrew on Linux out.
